LESSON: SEWING TOOLS, EQUIPMENT AND MATERIALS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE
Strand: Clothing and Textiles
Topic 3.1: Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials, part of Clothing and Textiles in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: when selecting How are sewing tools, equipment and materials maintained?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search for information from print and digital media and classify sewing tools, equipment and materials (cutting, marking, sewing, measuring, finishing, storage). Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolutions could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour,

2. search using adapted digital and print media for information on sewing machine (parts, use, faults, remedies, care and storage) and make notes,

3. use digital or print media to search, brainstorm and present findings on factors to consider

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search for information from print and digital media and classify sewing tools, equipment and materials (cutting, marking, sewing, measuring, finishing, storage). Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolutions could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour,
2. search using adapted digital and print media for information on sewing machine (parts, use, faults, remedies, care and storage) and make notes,
3. use digital or print media to search, brainstorm and present findings on factors to consider

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learners show a concerted attention to detail while selecting, using and caring for sewing tools and

equipment

● Digital literacy: Learners use digital technology to search for information on use of sewing tools, equipment and materials.

Values:
● Responsibility: As the learner cares for own sewing tools, equipment and materials and those in the Home science

laboratory.

39

● Integrity: As the learner displays honesty when using, caring for and storing different sewing tools, equipment and

materials.

40

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Safety and Security (Online safety): As learners search for information from the internet on sewing tools, equipment and

materials.

● Citizenship Education, integrity and leadership: As the learners interact with the community when going to visit shops that

sell sewing tools, equipment and materials.

Suggested learning resource:

Adapted digital devices and print reference materials, video clips, charts and pictures, relevant textbooks, shops that sell tools,

adapted sewing equipment and materials
